title: Add ability to snooze a notification
line: Notification popups get a clock button to snooze them for 15 minutes, 1 hour or 4 hours, after which they pop up again.
explanation:
A notification popup could only stay on screen until it timed out or be closed; there was no way to have it come back later. The library had no notion of hiding a notification for a while without closing it on the application's side.

libnotificationmanager gains Notifications::snooze(index, minutes): it marks the notification expired (the popup goes away, the app is not told it was closed, so it stays in the history with working actions) and a timer later marks it unexpired and unread, so the popup shows again. The popup header gets a clock button with a menu (For 15 minutes / 1 hour / 4 hours), shown for normal notifications only, not jobs, and the popup's timeout is paused while that menu is open.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: add a button to snooze notification popups

There was no way to put a notification off until later: it either had to
stay on screen or be closed. A clock button in the popup header now
hides it for 15 minutes, 1 hour or 4 hours, then shows it again unread.

BUG: 445560

media.caption: Master: a notification popup only offers Close
Patched: clock button in the popup header, menu with For 15 minutes / For 1 hour / For 4 hours
After choosing For 15 minutes at 10:55 the popup is gone; at 11:10 it pops up again (15 min ago)
